title: Generated Dependabot pull requests use a bounded machine contract
oracle: An authentic Dependabot pull request may omit the human semantic template only when its target, revision, ecosystem branch, generated dependency trace, commit authors, and changed files satisfy the ecosystem-specific machine contract.
known_bad: Route authentic Dependabot pull requests back through the human-only semantic body contract, causing every untouched generated update body to fail before its dependency checks can run.
prevention: generated metadata, commit provenance, and current-head validation
